> the config generator would also generate the ENRs I believe in a file right <@412614104222531604> / <@808969530608451584> ? so ability to pick from file would be good to have
The config generator won't, but once you deploy the devnet - ansible would do a post task where it fetches all the enrs + enodes and puts it into a file. It looks like this:
https://github.com/ethpandaops/fusaka-devnets/tree/master/network-configs/devnet-3/metadata

but yeah you can expect a nodes.yaml file, that feels like a standard way to go forward
